name: 21_21 DESIGN SIGHT
funding: Run by the Issey Miyake Design Culture Foundation. October 2026 corporate partners: Mitsui Fudosan, Miyake Design Studio, Issey Miyake Inc and Shiseido as main partners, plus 20 other firms.
watch: Main partner Mitsui Fudosan co-develops Jingu Gaien; ICOMOS issued a Heritage Alert on 5 September 2023 and a petition drew about 225,000 signatures.
why_flagged: Main partner Mitsui Fudosan co-develops Jingu Gaien; ICOMOS issued a Heritage Alert on 5 September 2023 and a petition drew about 225,000 signatures.

name: A4 Arts Foundation
funding: Endowed not-for-profit foundation (Wendy Fisher / Kirsh Foundation) and independent institutional partners.
watch: 2018 boycott call over the funder's security holdings.
why_flagged: 2018 boycott call over the funder's security holdings.
records_note: No annual reports, accounts, donor list or board found; the team page lists staff only.

name: African Artists' Foundation
watch: Deutsche Bank, a name under active campaign, is shown under 'Sponsors and Partners' on AAF's own collaborators page. The listing is undated, so it counts as a current excluded funder.
why_flagged: Deutsche Bank, a name under active campaign, is shown under 'Sponsors and Partners' on AAF's own collaborators page. The listing is undated, so it counts as a current excluded funder.

name: Aichi Triennale
watch: In 2019 the state withdrew its subsidy over a censorship row, then partly restored it.
why_flagged: In 2019 the state withdrew its subsidy over a censorship row, then partly restored it.
records_note: Aichi Triennale posts event reports for 2019 and 2025, the 2025 one with committee income and spending and named sponsors; it names only its chair.

name: Akron Art Museum
funding: $5.4M expenses (2023); private donors, foundations and members.
watch: FirstEnergy Foundation is a current key supporter. FirstEnergy's own generation is 99% coal, and it paid a $230M fine over Ohio's HB6 bribery case. No protest found.
why_flagged: FirstEnergy Foundation is a current key supporter. FirstEnergy's own generation is 99% coal, and it paid a $230M fine over Ohio's HB6 bribery case. No protest found.
records_note: Its Form 990 is public for 2001 to 2025 and it lists its board and names key supporters undated, but posts no annual reports.

name: Amandus Festival
watch: Crown Princess Mette-Marit had been high patron of the Amandus Festival, a youth film festival in Lillehammer, since 2006.
why_flagged: Youth film festival for ages 13 to 20. Its site lists supporters including the Norwegian Film Institute, Innlandet county, Lillehammer municipality, Sparebankstiftelsen and Fritt Ord.
records_note: The foundation behind it files accounts with the Norwegian register, latest 2025; its site names a seven-member board but shows funders only as logos.

name: American Folk Art Museum
funding: Private philanthropy, grants, and public foundation support; always free admission.
watch: Its first UAW Local 2110 collective bargaining contract was ratified on 2 October 2026, averting a strike.

name: American Museum of Natural History
watch: Koch left 2016; Mercer removed 2020; Sackler renamed 2023.
why_flagged: Koch left 2016; Mercer removed 2020; Sackler renamed 2023.
records_note: It posts annual reports and audited financial statements through 2025 and names its trustees; its donor list was not checked.

name: Anchorage Museum
watch: Excluded funders are current. The museum's 2022 contributors list (the newest one published) names Chevron Corporation, ConocoPhillips Alaska Inc. and Bloomberg Philanthropies. Its contemporary Alaska Native art gallery still carries the name ConocoPhillips Gallery on the museum's site in 2026. No protest at the museum was found.

name: Arab-Hebrew Theatre of Jaffa (Al-Saraya)
funding: Partly funded by Israel's Ministry of Culture and the Tel Aviv Municipality. In 2017 co-director Igal Ezrati put public funds at nearly NIS 900,000, a significant share of its budget.
watch: Police barred two film screenings in 2024, the theatre told the High Court. In 2017 Minister Regev asked the Finance Ministry to cut funding.
why_flagged: Partly funded by Israel's Ministry of Culture and the Tel Aviv Municipality. In 2017 co-director Igal Ezrati put public funds at nearly NIS 900,000, a significant share of its budget.
records_note: Its site shows no reports or donors; the public board of 27 is listed, and filings sit in the Israeli nonprofit register.

name: ARoS
funding: Aarhus Municipality, Salling Fonden, Ny Carlsbergfondet and many foundations. Augustinus Fonden backed several 2025 shows and gave grants of DKK 2M for 2026 projects.
watch: Danish art museum topped by Olafur Eliasson's 'Your rainbow panorama'.
why_flagged: Aarhus Municipality, Salling Fonden, Ny Carlsbergfondet and many foundations. Augustinus Fonden backed several 2025 shows and gave grants of DKK 2M for 2026 projects.
